title: Plans for Marine and Offshore Engineering Sector, Singapore's Carbon Utilisation and Storage, and Low-carbon Hydrogen Sector
what_it_is: Plans for Marine and Offshore Engineering Sector, Singapore's Carbon Utilisation and Storage, and Low-carbon Hydrogen Sector

sections.label: Hydrogen and CCUS questions
sections.summary: Questions ask the Minister for Trade and Industry about assessment of low-carbon hydrogen, hydrogen transport carriers, commercial viability, Singapore as a hydrogen hub, and CCUS.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) whether the Ministry has done any assessment of the low-carbon hydrogen sector; (b) if so, what is the current state of the art for hydrogen transportation by carrier; (c) at what point will carrier-transported hydrogen become commercially viable; (d) what is Singapore's potential to be a hydrogen hub; and (e) whether moving ahead of market shifts may be considered as a strategy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) whether he can provide an update on the current state of carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS); (b) what are the respective conservative and optimistic assessments of potential CCUS technological advancements in the next decade; and (c) what role can incentives play to improve CCUS commercial viability for purposes of deployment in the petrochemicals sector.

sections.label: Singapore 2030 climate submissions
sections.summary: In March 2020, Singapore submitted its enhanced 2030 Nationally Determined Contribution and Long-term Low Emissions Development Strategy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: In March 2020, Singapore submitted our enhanced 2030 Nationally Determined Contribution and Long-term Low Emissions Development Strategy, or LEDS.

sections.label: Low-carbon research funding and MOUs
sections.summary: A $49-million Low Carbon Energy Research Funding Initiative was launched, and MOUs with Australia, Chile and New Zealand cover low-carbon cooperation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Last year, we launched a $49-million Low Carbon Energy Research (LCER) Funding Initiative for the next five years to improve the technical and economic feasibility of low-carbon technologies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: At the same time, we are collaborating with international partners to further the development of low-carbon technologies, both in RD&D and the development of supply chains.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have signed an MOU with Australia on cooperation in Low Emissions Solutions and an MOU with Chile on Low-carbon Hydrogen Collaboration and we have just signed an arrangement regarding Collaboration on Low-carbon Hydrogen with New Zealand as well.

sections.label: Refreshed ITM and opportunities
sections.summary: Agencies are updating the ITM for COVID-19 and low-carbon transition, targeting launch next year, with offshore renewables and hydrogen carrier transport as opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Agencies are updating the ITM to take into account the impact of COVID-19 and the implications of a low-carbon transition and we target to launch a refreshed ITM next year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We expect offshore renewables and offshore carrier transport of hydrogen to be among the areas of opportunity in the refreshed ITM.

sections.label: Neste and Arkema
sections.summary: One of them is Neste and the other one is Arkema.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: One of them is Neste and the other one is Arkema.

sections.label: Blue hydrogen import strategy
sections.summary: Renewable energy would be needed to produce hydrogen locally, so a strategy of importing blue hydrogen and liberating it here was adopted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We would need renewable energy to produce this hydrogen here, locally.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Hence, we have decided to adopt a strategy where we look at blue hydrogen, which is a low-carbon form of hydrogen, and how we can import it and then look at liberating that hydrogen from here.

sections.label: Emission halving and carbon neutrality
sections.summary: The plan is to halve emissions by 2050 and reach zero carbon neutrality in the second half of this century.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Today, our plan is to halve the emission by 2050 and to reach carbon neutrality of zero sometime in the second half of this century.

sections.label: Low Carbon Energy Research Funding initiative
sections.summary: A Low Carbon Energy Research Funding initiative is a multi-agency initiative involving A*STAR, EDB, EMA, the National Climate Change Secretariat and NRF.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We are looking at a couple of projects.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I think, currently, there is a Low Carbon Energy Research Funding initiative, which is a multi-agency initiative involving A*STAR, Economic Development Board (EDB), Energy Market Authority (EMA), as well as the National Climate Change Secretariat and the National Research Foundation (NRF).

sections.label: Renewable energy imports from ASEAN
sections.summary: Imports from ASEAN countries with geographical advantage in producing low or zero carbon renewable energy are immediate short-term measures to reduce carbon footprint.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: On a limited basis, it is something that we could potentially look at, depending on the proposals that come in.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But one of the key things that we are actively pursuing is looking at imports.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We are looking at imports from the ASEAN countries and where we think that the countries that have maximum geographical advantage in terms of producing renewable energy with very low carbon or zero carbon, those are the immediate short-term measures that we will be moving forward to reduce our carbon footprint.
